articleTitle: Research on the Controller Area Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A controller area network (CAN) is ideally suited to the many high-level industrial protocols embracing CAN and ISO 11898 as their physical layer. Its cost, performance, and upgradeability provide for tremendous flexibility in system design. This paper presents a brief introduction to the CAN operating principles, the implementation of a basic CAN bus using Texas Instrument’s CAN transceivers and DSPs, and a discussion of the robust error detection and fault confinement mechanisms. Some of the properties of the enhanced Controller Area Network (eCAN) are then discussed.

articleTitle: Cooperative Incentive Mechanism Based on Game Theory in MANET
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In mobile ad hoc net work, transmitting a packet from source to destination needs cooperation among nodes. Since there may be selfish nodes in the network and these selfish nodes are reluctant to relay packets for other nodes in order to protect resources of their own, the performance of the whole network will be influenced. We propose a cooperative incentive mechanism based on game theory. When determining the utility function, we fully take into account the dependence between the nodes, cooperation capability as well as energy consumption. Simulation and analysis results show that our incentive mechanism can stimulate the cooperation among the nodes and improve the performance of network efficiently.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Load Balancing Strategy of Sequential Tasks for Computational Grids
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Load balancing is crucial to computational grids. Based on the typeof information on which corresponding decisions are made, loadbalancing approaches can be generally categorized into two classes:average-based and instantaneous approaches. Both these two classeshave merits and demerits. It's therefore advantageous to combineboth of them to work in tandem to form a hybrid approach that makesthe best of the strong points of each. In this paper, we present ahybrid load balancing strategy for sequential tasks in computationalgrids with the purpose to improve the performance by a joint effort.The simulation results show that our algorithm can achieve a betterload balancing performance than its counterparts provided insimulation.

articleTitle: The Electronic Records Management in E-government Strategy: Case Studies and the Implications
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Electronic records management (ERM) is fundamental to good governance, business efficiency and effectiveness of e-government in networking and digital society. However, government authorities in China has faced many challenges in managing electronic records. A study of ERM in e-government strategy in other countries would be significant to support development of ERM in Chinese e-government strategy. As little is known from literature on the status of electronic records management in e-government strategy, this paper selects U.S, New Zealand and UK for case study by means of collecting and analyzing publications, laws, regulations and policies relevant to both electronic records management and e-government strategy. The author first analyzes status of ERM in e-government strategy and then discusses models and driving forces of their existences. The result of the study revealed that electronic records are managed as national assets, resources and trusted information in the e-government strategy. Driven by core business of e-government in different country, there are different approaches to ERM in e-government strategy. The implications of the study is that, to position ERM in e-government strategy, it is significant to provide a strategic approach to ERM for shared agenda by both government authorities and records management professionals. The findings intended to be of use to both the effective e-government strategy and good ERM for dynamic, interactive and proactive citizen-centered services across domains and time dimensions.

articleTitle: A DCT Domain Color Watermarking Scheme Based on Chaos and Multilayer Arnold Transformation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A novel DCT domain color digital watermarking scheme based on chaotic maps is proposed, and the host image is color RGB image. The color space of the color host image is first converted from RGB to YIQ. In order to resist JPEG compression, all three watermark RGB channel signals are buried to Y component of the YIQ color space host images. In the proposed method, the image watermark is embedded into low-band DCT coefficients with different strength according to the characteristics of human vision system. The watermark signal and the embedding position of the host image are encrypted respectively by the unified chaotic map and multilayer Arnold cat map, and compared with the general Arnold cat map, the key space is highly increased. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme possesses the invisibility and the robustness to common image processing attacks, such as noise addition, JPEG compression, image rotation, cutting and so on.

articleTitle: Analysis, Implementation and Extensions of RADIUS Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: RADIUS (Remote Authentication Dial In User Service) is an authentication, authorization and accounting protocol being widely used in network environments. However, it has a set of vulnerabilities that are either caused by the protocol, or caused by poor implementation and exacerbated by the protocol. First the overview of RADIUS protocol including basic operation of RADIUS protocol is studied. Then analysis part of RADIUS focuses on security issues, transport issues and implementation issues. In addition, how to minimize or resolve various issues of the RADIUS protocol using deployment best practices and extensions are discussed.

articleTitle: Information Systems Risk Evaluation Based on the AHP-Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The AHP-Fuzzy assessment method is a combination which unifies the AHP method and the fuzzy mathematics. AHP can synthesize human's subjective qualitative judgment, form the weighting of each policy- making factor, and avoid appearing the logic reasoning fault in the complex decision-making question. The fuzzy mathematics, simulating the characteristic of human in making the judgment, is good at processing the uppercase, the ambiguous information. Therefore, AHP-Fuzzy, unifying AHP and the fuzzy assessment method, can unify both merits, and make decision-making more scientific. Through the introduction of AHP, the combination of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation from a combination of qualitative and quantitative point of view for the establishment of an integrated information system risk assessment model.

articleTitle: Information Technology and Its Application in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Modern information technology pays more and more attention to e-learning in higher education. This paper discusses the development of information technology and analyzes the application of information technology in e-learning for college students in distance education. E-learning offers a unique opportunity. Information technology provides higher education with the potential to disseminate knowledge to more people than ever before. It combines the power of today’s technology and global networks with the infinite economic potential that is unleashed when people acquire, create and apply knowledge and skills. Information technology in distance education is delivered via both analog and digital technologies, including diverse combinations of telephone connections, tele-courses, video conferences and computer transmissions. Information technology for distance learning programs is a reflection of this new world. It offers education without borders. It grows out of today’s technological revolution. It aims to be individualized, interactive, and independent of time, emphasizing learning over teaching and commonality of outcomes over commonality of processes.

articleTitle: MPSK Signal Modulation Recognition Based on Wavelet Transformation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: There is rich information of phase in MPSK. Different wavelet coefficient peak collection probability density function and different maximum likelihood function of different MPSK can be obtained from its phase information. These parameters can be used to do modulation recognition for MPSK. In this paper, Morlet wavelet is used to extract the different probability density function and maximum likelihood function from three modulation signals which are BPSK, QPSK, 8PSK. The value of M is got by mode recognition. Simulation shows that the method is perfect for modulation recognition under the condition that SNR is low (greater than or equal to 4dB).

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Networks for Corporation Credit Rating Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this study we are trying with the neural network model to make an effective analysis for corporation credit rating. A 12-25-1 three-layer feedforward neural network using the backpropagation and Levenberg-Marquardt algorithms has been used in the proposed artificial neural network. The experiment results show that this network is efficient and forms a useful tool for the prediction of corporation credit rating.

articleTitle: Research and Design on the Refinery ERP and EERP Based on SOA and the Component Oriented Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The current business challenge and solution supported by EERP (End-to-End Resource Planning) is presented in this paper. An approach based on SOA and component technology for EERP has been proposed and applied, which can help to realize business-goal-driven dynamic semantic integration of the web services. After analyzing the profit points and service requirements in the refinery enterprise production value chains in depth, it develops the component libraries and gives a solution to build the ERP and EERP information systems based on SOA. Considering of the two aspects about technology and management, this paper investigates the new approach to accomplish the enterprise information system. It has more advantages to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the market, to speed up the accomplishing process of information systems, and then can help enterprise to decrease their cost and enhance competition ability.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Web Services Security Based on XML Signature
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the development of web services application, some issues of web services security are increasingly prominent. XML is widely used of its high expansibility as a platform-independent language. After analysis the traditional web services security technology, this paper formulates the XML signature, as the basis of web services security technology, and describes how to create and verify signature. An implementation of XML signature in the Web services security is illustrated in Java.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Logic-Based Rate Adaption Scheme for TFMCC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper proposes a fuzzy-logic-based rate adaption scheme named FRA in order to enhance the smoothness of TCP-Friendly Multicast Congestion Control (TFMCC). To alleviate oscillation of sending rate for TFMCC sender, FRA introduces five actions for adjusting rate and uses a fuzzy controller to decide which action should be taken according to the feedback information from CLR (current limiting receiver). Unsymmetrical membership functions and biased fuzzy inference rules make FRA as friendly to TCP flows as TFMCC. Simulation results show that FRA has excellent smoothness and fine TCP-Friendliness.

articleTitle: Fast Audio Fingerprint Search Strategy for Song Identification
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper we present an audio fingerprinting (AF) system for song identification. For the high dimensional audio fingerprint data, two AF searching algorithms were proposed and implemented: Principle Component Analysis (PCA) and the summation of the corresponding data between different frames. The experimental results show that applying PCA algorithm, the accuracy is 94.98% while the search time is as low as 8.42%; applying Sum algorithm, the accuracy is 95.92% while the search time is as low as 3.72%. A top-N Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) searching is applied to the dimension-reduced data before the exact search of N full dimension data. The final realization shows an accuracy rate of 96.11% with 8.85% of search time compared with the full search method.

articleTitle: An Improved Authentication Protocol with Less Delay for UMTS Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To provide secure communication for universal mobile telecommunications system (UMTS) Mobile Networks, authentication and key agreement (AKA) is carried out between the user and the home environment, and the authentication protocol is an important primitive for entity authentication and session keys. The current authentication protocol is giving a reasonable security level. However it is overloading the network with significant signaling traffic and increasing the call setup time. The signaling load and authentication delay are of particular importance for the efficient authentication. In this paper, we will study and analyze the current authentication protocol, and propose an improved scheme. The proposed protocol only requires a little modification based on the current protocol. It reduces the number of messages and requires less traffic, bandwidth between the user and visited location register (VLR). The more apparent improvement is that the proposed scheme is clearly causing less delay, and it can be better used in UMTS networks.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Key Technology Based on Internet Encryption and Authentication
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In view of the current limitations of Internet security,it designed a system of encryption and authentication base on Internet system. It detail realizes network security features of data confidentiality, data integrity, data origin authentication and access control and so on. Combine the actual application, it given specific implementation of the encryption and authentication.

articleTitle: Analysis of Concurrent Security Protocols Using Colored Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Colored Petri Nets (CPN) are a well known formalism for modeling concurrency. We extend a version of CPN method for analyzing cryptographic protocols. By establishing modeling and analysis techniques of CPN, it can be verified whether any security threats exist when many instances of the protocol are executed concurrently. Our method contributes greatly to understanding of the concurrent security of cryptographic protocols, along with constructio

articleTitle: Modeling of Network Education Effectiveness Evaluation in Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The effectiveness of Network education in China has become the key to the development of e-learning; to build an effective system to assess the effectiveness of network education is an important means of improving the network education effectiveness. According to the primary factors that influence the network education effectiveness, this paper establishes a relatively comprehensive system of evaluated guideline. The index weight factors are achieved with AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) method. The sub-effectiveness value is combined into the network education effectiveness system with Fuzzy Mathematic method. Finally, an example is given.

articleTitle: An Auto-Recognition System for Pointer-Meter Based on TLS Analytic Resolution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents an auto-recognition system of pointer table computer. It analyzes the method to locate image of pointer in this system. And TLS, which is used to solve the pointerpsilas fitting line problem, is proposed with its formulas deduced process. In comparison with LMS, it isnpsilat influenced by the posture of pointers, and can fitting the location of the center of pointer table in precision. This system can be used not only in instrument testing but also in cases which are not suitable for manual operation.

articleTitle: Interactive Visualization for 3D Pipelines Using Ajax3D
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The traditional development of 3D Web-GIS Applications is mainly based on the COM component of GIS software, which provides 3D visualization library and client-sever software architectures. This development method is still not sufficient in supporting the remote management of 3D pipelines because the client and the server involved in the process may require a frequent, two-way communication as well as an intuitive visualization of modeling results. In this paper we propose a solution to web 3D pipeline management system which provides convenience of operation, exactness of position and rapidness of update for the road sight in the web context. We realize web-based interactive visualization for 3D pipelines management system using Ajax3D.

articleTitle: Gateways Placement Optimization in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In a wireless mesh network, the traffic is aggregated at mesh router and most of them forwarded towards the Internet through GW (Internet gateway). Thus easily leads to a bottleneck for network performance at GW. Aimed to this problem ,we firstly treated the GW and mesh router as the alike node equivalently. Then used the logarithm-normal distribution model of shadow affect in wireless communication to design a weighted objective function for guarantee nodepsilas connectivity and coverage, attained the deployment location of the candidate GW; Based of the generated connectivity graph of the network and the constraints of the gateway deployment, consider a heuristic TSP (tree-set partition) algorithm based on degree/weighted to get a good choice of nodes with high throughput and better connectivity act as GW configuration. In conclusion, we validated our ideas and achieved a certain optimization effect under NS2 simulation.

articleTitle: Application Research of Anti-interference Technology of Network Communication Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This article analyzes the interference problems existed in the running process of network communication electronic equipment. According to the typical problems about universal electromagnetic compatibility and anti-jamming in the network engineering practice, such as grounding technology problem, application of circuit isolation technology, cable interference suppression, improvements in the quality of power supply, etc. the preferred solution and technical plans are presented. Relevant new technologies and the application of new technologies are introduced as well.

articleTitle: An Exploration Strategy for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping in Large Environments
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Itpsilas preferred that a hierarchical map is adopted to describe large environments, as seen in the literatures about the hierarchical simultaneous localization and mapping (HSLAM). With an automaton map at the upper layer and a set of feature-based maps at the lower layer, both macro and micro localization are realized. A novel exploration strategy which guides and supervises the mapping progress based on supervisory control of discrete event systems is proposed. Itpsilas embodied in the system and implemented as a supervisor which permits some desired actions to occur and prohibits undesired actions.

articleTitle: The Novel Cross-Layer Design for Channel Access in Ad Hoc Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the framework of ad-hoc cognitive radio network (ad-hoc CRN), the network model and the dynamic spectrum access (DSA) for ad-hoc cognitive radio network first. Moreover, the motivation for cross-layer design in ad-hoc cognitive radio network is analysis. At last, we proposed a novel architecture in which the dynamic channel allocation is achieved by a cross-layer design between the PHY and MAC layers for ad-hoc cognitive radio network. Simulation indicated the performance of network is improved significantly.

articleTitle: The Geographic Information System Based on Distributed Parallel Computation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS) has been widely used in the geotechnical engineering field, but it is incompetent in real-time computation. In this paper, the Geographic Information System based on distributed parallel computation named GISPC is introduced. The implementation of domain decomposition on the server is the preprocessing of parallel computation. With the method of adopting MPI on Cluster of Workstation (COW) platform in the system, the parallel FEM codes can be implemented by C++ Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) technique. The large-scale geotechnical problems can be successfully solved on PC machine groups by using these techniques. And the system is capable of internet publication. It enables fast storage and retrieval of large amounts of information stored in the server through intranet and internet. The instance of Longtan high slope is shown to prove the applicability of these methods. The results show the feasibility of the proposed methods for the extensive application of GIS in geotechnical engineering.

articleTitle: A QoS Ontology for Semantic Service Discovery
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: QoS is essential for selecting an appropriate service from a set of services that match user’s functionality requirements. To enable this, a QoS Ontology for semantic service discovery, which provide the uniform model for QoS, is proposed in this article. With this ontology, the algorithms for QoS matchmaking and service ranking are presented.

articleTitle: Developing a Framework for Business Intelligence Systems Integration Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Abstract—The paper analyzes the current situation of businessenvironment and business intelligence systems(BIS)framework at first, and studies the theoretics and methodsabout the business intelligence system based on ontology.Based on ontology, this paper proposes an integrationframework for business intelligence systems. A serviceresource based-ontology is proposed in this research, includingthe Data Model Patterns and Ontology mode, which theproblem that face integration of business intelligence systemsbased on different dada sources and structure. Furthermore,based on the knowledge ontology, the essentialities of resourceand the hierarchy relation are presented by a case study andthe construction method of service resource base is given. Itcan help confirm the keystone of the construction of businessintelligence systems.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Association Rules Methods in Data Mining for Commercial Sales Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper introduces the application of association rules methods in data mining and the FP-tree algorithm for mining association rules in commercial sales analysis. It begins with the discussion of the concepts of association rules, followed by the analysis of mining for association rules and the FP-tree algorithm, and ended with their applications in commercial sales analysis as well as the demonstration case study.

articleTitle: Integration of RFID Technique and E-commerce Logistics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Development of digital technique has accelerated the development of E-Commerce rapidly. This paper discusses the possibility of combining RFID (radio frequency identification) technique with E-Commerce Logistics based on the analysis of the characteristics and basic theory of RFID technique and it expounds the scope where RFID technique can be applied in E-Commerce Logistics. Comparing with other identification techniques, RFID has its unique advantages. To apply RFID technique in E-Commerce Logistics can raise the efficiency of E-Commerce Logistics operating process, and can monitor the whole logistics management process in a dynamic way as well. In the same time, it also has great meanings on optimizing supply chain resources allocation, monitoring supply chain operating and raising the integrated performance of supply chain.

articleTitle: File View: Secure Model in Intranet
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: At present, the electronic document in Intranet is not flexible enough in use. We cannot authorize different paragraphs of one document to different persons in file system. Furthermore, there are two security requirements of e-document: (a) The inadvertent disclosure of the commercial confidential information by legal user causes enormous losses. (b) Once the commercial confidential information is stolen, there is a lack of the file accessing history for tracing. To satisfy these requirements, we propose the concept of "File View" which is used the mechanism of database view for reference. We divide the files in file system into logical blocks. A file view is a set of logical blocks of different files through multi-layered mapping as database view. By this way, users can access the content of files more flexibly. Then, we define access control of the body and the content of file view respectively to strengthen security of the file accessing. Finally, we suggest to record effective processes of files and file views which for further reinforcing the security of the file system. Once commercial confidential information is stolen, we can trace the transfer path of files and locate the hidden trouble in Intranet for reducing the losses as much as possible.

articleTitle: Non-transitive Bidirectional Proxy Re-encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In 1998, Blaze, Bleumer and Strauss proposed two kinds of cryptographic primitives called proxy re-encryption and proxy re-signature [4]. In proxy re-encryption, a proxy can transform a ciphertext computed under Alice's public key into one that can be opened under Bob's decryption key. In proxy re-signature, a proxy can transform a signature computed under Alice's secret key into one that can be verified by Bob's public key. They divided the proxy re-cryptography into two kinds: One kind is bidirectional proxy re-cryptography and the other kind is unidirectional proxy re-cryptography. In 2005, Ateniese et al proposed the first unidirectional proxy re-encryption schemes and discussed its several potential applications especially in secure distributed storage [1]. In 2006, they proposed another few re-signature schemes and also discussed its several potential applications [2]. In 2007, Canetti and Hohenberger proposed the first chosen ciphertext secure bidirectional proxy re-encryption schemes [6]. In this paper, we show that there exists a security flaw in all the bidirectional proxy re-cryptography schemes proposed until now. Specially, all the bidirectional proxy re- cryptography schemes can not satisfy the non-transitive property. The proxy himself can generate re-encryption key or re-signature key rk<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">aharrc</sub> by giving re-encryption key rk<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">aharrb</sub> and rk<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bharrc</sub>. Thus we propose a new framework for proxy re-encryption. This new framework can bring us two benefits: First, the delegator can now relocate delegation right easily. Second, we can construct bidirectional proxy re-cryptography schemes which are no longer transitive. Based on this framework, we construct a concrete non-transitive proxy re-encryption scheme.

articleTitle: Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible Virus Spread Model in 2-Dimension Regular Network under Local Area Control
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A local area control SIS model based on 2 dimension regular network is proposed. The process of virus spreading is studied in 2 dimension regular network under local area control. The research suggests that with the span of local area control increases, the stable infected proportion to reduce. The theoretical analysis and analog simulation shows that there is a critical value in the model. Only when the product of spreading efficiency beyond the critical value, can the virus spread in the network continuously and stably.

articleTitle: The Research of a Structural P2P Model Based on Mobile Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper provides the C-Chord model which is a Peer-to-Peer overlay network strategy based on mobile cellular networks. In according with theories of Chord model and the landmark cluster, and making use of characteristics of cellular architectures and base stations in mobile cellular network, C-Chord model is formed master Chord ring by all base stations and formed slave Chord ring by the mobile terminal nodes in every cellular region, so C-Chord model is two-dimensional structure to mobile cellular networks. C-Chord model uses the station as the landmark node and cellular region as the landmark district by landmark cluster method, which not only implements nodes that their physical location are close are proximate in logical location, but also solves single node failure in landmark cluster method, so C-Chord model is a more appropriate Peer-to-Peer model to the mobile cellular network.

articleTitle: Fast Binary Dilation/Erosion Algorithm Using Reference Points
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A new method of fast binary image dilation/erosion operation called RPI is proposed in this paper. Without the regularity of structure elements or pixel processing sequence, dilation/erosion operation can be carried out by looking up a precomputed increments table with this algorithm. The definition of reference points set and coding method for fast looking up the combination status, including its algorithm framework, are given. Compared with KSD algorithm, the average performance of RPI algorithm is a little h. However, RPI algorithm becomes more effective in the worst case and is more suitable for real-time image processing.

articleTitle: Automatic Testing System for UHF Passive RFID Tag Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the advancement of radio frequency identification technology, various RFID products are emerging in our life. More and more government agencies and retailers have realized the potential of RFID technology and have mandated or recommended their suppliers to attach RFID tags to their products. The tag performance highly determines implement of these mandates and recommendations. In this paper, we discuss an automatic testing system for UHF passive RFID tag performance. Both hardware and software architectures will be presented.

articleTitle: Design of Protection Technology in WDM Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Protection and survivability are very important problems in optical network. With the rapid development of WDM optical network, protection technology is paid more and more attentions. In this paper, we analyze the protection principle of WDM optical network, propose a protection method for optical network. Protection schemes can be divided into link protection, path protection, and partial path protection schemes. Path protection can be further subdivided into dedicated path protection and shared path protection. In the dedicated path protection schemes, spare capacity is reserved for each individual end-to-end lightpath whilst in the shared path protection schemes, spare capacity is shared among multiple lightpaths, as long as those lightpaths do not fail simultaneously. Lightpaths sharing the same backup resources must be path-disjoint.

articleTitle: Description and Analysis of Fairness on Temporal Logic of Actions
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: TLA(Temporal Logic of Actions) and it’s specifying language TLA+ have become an efficient and convenient approach for model checking, and fairness is a vital property in TLA. We try to analyze the definitions of fairness based on TLA, point out a fallible question on the definition of fairness in cited literature [5], improve it more clearly and prove the consistency of syntax and semantics of fairness, and subdivide the fairness in the end.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient Traffic-Based Key Management Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In Wireless Sensor Networks, most of the existing key management schemes, establish shared keys for all pairs of neighbor sensors without considering the communication between these nodes. This results in causing huge overhead. For large scale WSNs, these schemes still need each sensor to be loaded with a bulky amount of keys. In many-to-one traffic pattern of sensor networks, large numbers of sensor nodes send data to single or few base stations. Thus a sensor node may communicate with a small set of neighbors. Based on this fact, in this paper, a novel Traffic-Aware Key Management (EETKM) scheme is developed for WSNs, which only establishes shared keys for active sensors which participate in direct communication, based on the topology information of the network. Numerical results show that proposed key management scheme achieves high connectivity. In the simulation experiments, the proposed key management scheme is applied for different routing protocols. Simulation results show that proposed key management scheme achieves stronger resilience against node capture and low energy consumption.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Segmentation Based on Improved Active Contour
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Snake (active contour) model, introduced by Kass in 1987, is a dynamic curve model with energy-minimizing. Snake algorithm, which has advantages in extracting target object from a certain region, is an effective method in image segmentation. Based on the analysis of the snake model and the regional information of the edges of the fingerprint images, an improved active contour for the segmentation of fingerprints is presented in this paper. In this paper the limitations of the segmentation of fingerprint images using the snake as suggested are pointed out. The authors present a solution to the fingerprint segmentation by replacing the standard external energy in the snake energy balance equation with the difference between peaks in the directional histogram and gray variance, and a new external energy that is applied to control the snake outward expansion or inward contraction. This method has been tested by a large number of fingerprint images from different sources, and is found to be more accurate and robust.

articleTitle: Application of Rough Set and Fuzzy Neural Network in Information Handling
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, based on rough set, the design of fuzzy neural network is studied. The character of rough fuzzy neural network and other neural network are analyzed and compared. The validity of the rough fuzzy neural network can be verified in extracting sound quality parameters from the scene image. The rough fuzzy neural network has superiorities at the aspect of structure and convergence.

articleTitle: Real P2P System Measurement under Mobile IP Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Mobile p2p is a more and more interested topic. In this paper, we discuss the factors that can cause uncertain problems for current p2p systems under mobile ip environment. A simulation mobile ip environment based on real network is proposed. After analyzing the p2p measurement requirements on mobile ip networks, we design and build a p2p system measurement platform under the simulation mobile ip environment, on which we get traces for some typical p2p systems. The p2p measurement platform can be use in many other research works.

articleTitle: A Multi-task Real-Time Scheduling Algorithm Based on Dynamic Weight Compensation and Adaptive Task Jumping
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: For a certain real-time task scheduling problems with characteristics of uncertain task sets, the executing time dynamic changing and the task's mutual coupling strength dynamic changing, a multi-tasking dynamic scheduling algorithm is proposed based on dynamic weight value compensation and adaptive task jumping, which solved the loads storming caused by the dynamic task scheduling as well as the too long system response time caused by the changes of the tasks' coupling coefficient. The scheduling diagram and function of the modules are given firstly. Then, the focuses are the implementation of the execution controller and the weight compensation method based on the research of task weight value, the weight compensation and weight classification. The reliability and efficiency of the algorithm is verified by comparing tests, and has been applied to the combining heavy-duty train's braking condition monitoring and early warning system.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Design of One-Dimensional Nearly-Orthogonal Symmetric Wavelet Filter Banks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The design and analysis of one-dimensional (1D) nearly-orthogonal symmetric wavelet filter banks has been studied. Methods for analyzing the correlation of the nearly-orthogonal filter banks are proposed. The basic idea is to impose multiple zeros at the aliasing frequency to a symmetric filter, minimize the deviation of the filter satisfying the orthogonal condition, and then a nearly orthogonal filter bank can be obtained. The way in this paper is to find a FIR complementary filter of the minimized filter and thus construct a perfect reconstructed bi-orthogonal filter bank. Then a corresponding wavelet filter bank can be generated and correlation analysis can also be conducted. The integer translates of the wavelet at the same scale is also nearly-orthogonal, the disadvantage is that orthogonal degree of the integer translates of the wavelet at different scale is lower than that of the semi-orthogonal filter bank.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Technology in Open and Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Digital technologies have fostered a rapid expansion in recent years, distance education is a form of education in which students are separated from their instructors by time and/or space. Distance education is utilized in some form at every level of the educational spectrum, with the most extensive use in higher education. An individual course may contain both classroom and distance education components. In this paper, we analyze the development of digital technology, discuss the application of digital technology in open and distance education. Digital technology is used extensively for varied purposes and in varied ways, depending on the intended audience for the course, and the availability and cost of the technology. The capabilities of the new technologies have made possible a more interactive experience that more closely parallels face-to-face teaching which in effect creating a virtual classroom. They have also made distance education courses more convenient and better suited to the needs of different students, including by providing the benefits of both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

articleTitle: Improved Fairness Using DCCP in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper studies TCPpsilas fairness issues in WSNs, and designs an improved congestion control algorithm based on the characteristics of the WSNs (Wireless Sensor Networks). The protocol is designed as extension to DCCP (Datagram Congestion Control Protocol) with a new congestion control component. We also implemented this congestion control algorithm in NS2. Simulation results show improvements on fairness achieved by using Extend congestion control algorithm.

articleTitle: Revolutionary Information System Application in Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Biometrics is automatic methods for identifying a person on the basis of some biological or behavioral characteristic of the person. Many biological characteristics,such as fingerprints, and behavioral characteristics, such as voice patterns, are distinctive to each person. The purpose of this report is to introduce the revolutionary information system application of biometrics. After collecting and analyzing enough sources, this report makes the description of the technology, identify the business which used biometrics, and then discovered how the biometrics change the business model and the reasons why businesses should adopt biometrics, at last make the prediction of biometrics development.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Standard Part Library Development Based on Pro/TOOLKIT and Database
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Pro/TOOLKIT and FamilyTable provided by Pro/ENGINEER and Visual C++6.0 are utilized to develop three-dimensional standard part library of riveting joint according to national riveting joint standards. Feature based modeling and FamilyTable are used to construct three-dimensional riveting joint part library. The interface between Pro/ENGINEER and MFC is developed using DLLs to establish a man-machine interface that accords with engineering personnel’s habit. This breaks through the limitation of Pro/TOOLKIT. According to the newest Machinery Design Handbook, Microsoft Access databases of various rivets and rivet nuts are established, and the interface between Pro/ENGINEER and the Access databases is developed to call the data in the Access databases from Pro/ENGINEER. The library is intuitionistic and easy to use. Consequently, tediously repetitive work can be reduced, and product design efficiency and quality can be improved. The approach can also be applied to develop other more professional part libraries in special domains.

articleTitle: A Two-Level KNN Based Teaching Web Pages Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Web classification is considered to be an important and challenging task, it has extracted more and more research work in recent years. Due to domain diversity and complexity, there remain many problems not solved. This work is focus on teaching web page classification and a novel two-level classification model is proposed. Its processing including two steps: at first, the model employ global feature vector to recognize the content web page whether related to education, and then, the specific subject of education page were be identified in the second level by utilize the difference feature vector. The experiments show that the correct classification rate is improved, and the detailed result are listed in the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Comment on an ID-Based Broadcast Signcryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Broadcast encryption is an important cryptographicaltechnique. It allows a center to deliver the encrypted datato a large set of users so that only a particular subset ofprivileged users can decrypt it. Most of previous broadcastencryption schemes only provide confidentiality, while theycannot provide authentication and non-repudiation. Recently,Li et.al proposed a broadcast signcryption schemeto achieve authentication and non-repudiation. And theyclaimed that their scheme was secure against outside attackand inside attack. Unfortunately, we show that their schemeis insecure by analyzing its security and cannot be againstoutside attack and inside attack. Thus, their scheme cannotachieve authentication and non-repudiation.

articleTitle: The Design of a Ubiquitous Learning Enviroment from the Holistic View
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The continuous development of ubiquitous computing technologies and its applications have brought about a revolution in the education, especially in learning environments. However, these learning environments are often described as 1:1 educational computing, handheld educational computing, and technology-supported educational computing, and so on. To conceptualize and maximize advantages of ubiquitous environment in learning, we must carefully design it according to the holistic perspective. This paper introduces the holistic notion and the model of ubiquitous learning environment. It begins by exploring definition and characteristics of ubiquitous learning, and then gives our understandings of ubiquitous learning environment; after that, we put forward design ideas and a model of the ubiquitous learning environment from the holistic perspective, which includes five key components: physical environment, informational environment, technological environment, interactive environment, and learning community.

articleTitle: GMPLS Technology and Its Application in WDM Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Generalized multi-protocol label switching (GMPLS) is being developed by the IETF as the industry standard for transport network control planes. GMPLS defines IP based control of optical resources. Routers are expected to deliver advanced services at higher throughput while handling large amounts of label switching path (LSP) creation/deletion, traffic engineering link information exchange, and link state advertisements. In this paper, we discuss the GMPLS technology, analyze its application and design a novel WDM optical network with GMPLS technology. A single control plane, based on IP-like signaling and routing mechanisms that are being developed in the framework of generalized multi-protocol label switching, governs both layers. GMPLS provides the ability to automate many of the network functions that are directly related to the operational complexities. These functions include end-to-end provisioning of services, network resource discovery, bandwidth assignment and service creation.

articleTitle: Role Engineering with SKAOS for Systems Employing RBAC
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Access control is always essential for safe and security access to the system resource. Role based access control (RBAC) model is widely used in large enterprise software systems. The quality of the RBAC policy design especially role definition has great impact on the system security policy implementation. In this paper we propose a novel role engineering methods with security KAOS (SKAOS), which guide the engineering process via keeping decomposing the functional requirement objective and combining the system security requirement. SKAOS not only simplifies the system user’s involvement in the role engineering process via supplying with the objective decomposition but also reduces the complexity of the operation analysis. After building the objective decomposition and activity analysis diagrams, the role definition can be delivered. We illustrate the effectiveness of our method via analyzing a real world requirement problem.

articleTitle: Portable Ambulatory Electrocardiogram Monitoring System Based on Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to the waveform distortion problem existed in the portable ambulatory electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring system and analyzing the wireless Bluetooth technology working principle used in portable ECG monitoring system, the paper proposes an overall design idea of portable ambulatory ECG monitoring system based on Bluetooth and implementation program of system hardware and software . It can be seen from the analysis and contrast of performance test in laboratory and function test in hospital that the normal ECG of the person obtained by ECG monitor of a hospital can be in conformity to that obtained by the system in a rate as high as 99%. This system can realize the effective real-time diagnosis and monitoring. And it can make the connection with Internet a possibility. Thus the remote wireless monitoring comes true. This system can be applied widely.

articleTitle: E-government System Demand Analysis Based on Mind Map
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Several problems exist in traditional analysis and design for e-government: few solutions to dynamic user demand, heavy workload of document processing, complicated affair schemes and so on. Mind map is a method embodying radiant thinking. This paper adapts mind map for demand analysis, bringing many benefits to e-government planning, such as grasping emphasis immediately, affording a broad overall view, giving weight to details, being convenient to implement, etc. A comparative study of traditional demand analysis and mind map based method is carried out and a typical new e-government scenario "Government Project Application" is sampled to evaluate the application of mind map in e-government system analysis.

articleTitle: E-government Platform of Personalized Information Service Based on Gridding Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Information overload and inappropriate is becoming one of the problems that hinder the effectiveness of e-government services. We need an effective personalized platform and technology to solve this problem. Gridding management is a new management model and it was successfully applied on city management system such as police work, city environment and sanitation, traffic management, and water management etc. This study proposes a new e-government personalized information services platform architecture based on the ideas of girdding management. Government information resources must be subtly subdivided into different grid units and integrated in uniform platform revolving around the personalized information needs of public, so as to facilitate the public to find the information they need quickly. It can also check the validity of the user's information needs, arise userpsilas potential information needs, provide effective support for the sustaining changes in the personalized information services oriented the information needs of public.

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of a Simulation Model of Authentication Protocol of Ad Hoc
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A mobile ad hoc network is an up-to-date one emerging with the development of wireless communication technology. Nowadays, it has become more and more popular. Along with the development, more and more authentication protocols in ad hoc network have been proposed. But the problem is that how to validate the security and efficiency of these proposed protocols. In this paper, we proposed a general model for modeling and simulation of the authentication protocols at application layer in mobile ad hoc network based on OPNET simulation environment to test performance of the authentication protocols. A prototype is implemented taking an authentication protocol based on self-certified public key as an example. According to the analyses of the simulation results, the authentication protocol satisfies the request of mobility factor of the MANET nodes and the effect to the end-to-end delay is limited. Quantitative references are provided for the study of authentication protocols for the mobile ad hoc network

articleTitle: AKA Protocol and Its Formal Analysis and Verification Using Ambient Calculus and Logics
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, ambient calculus and ambient logics are introduced. Then we describe 3GPP authentication and key agreement protocol (AKA). This protocol’s goals are formally analyzed using ambient calculus. And we verified this protocol’s goals using Ambient Logics. It shows that AKA protocol can achieve successfully the goals of authentication and key agreement.

articleTitle: A Research on the Security of the Intelligent Mobile Phone System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the intelligent mobile phone being more and more popular, the mobile E-Commerce era has come silently; unavoidably, mobile E-Commerce will be subjected to the threat of virus, and cause some problems in information security. This article is designed to develop intelligent mobile phone short message firewall software to guarantee the normal operation of mobile E-Commerce through the research on security technology of mobile phone.

articleTitle: The Research of the Resource Consumption Index System on Wuhan City's Road Transport System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: By the study of the resources consumption on Wuhan citypsilas road transport system, and drawing domestic and international experience, this article established resource consumption index system on Wuhan citypsilas road transport system from five aspects: land-use, energy consumption, capital investment, environmental pollution and time consumption; designed the resource consumption evaluation model of Wuhan citypsilas road transport system, and chose Analytic Hierarchy Process to calculate the weight of each element index; through the data of each element index which was obtained by investigation and using ldquourban road and traffic planning design standardrdquo (GB50220-95) and ldquourban road and traffic management evaluation index systemrdquo for an evaluation standard, the score of each element index was reduced; finally, the comprehensive evaluation value was calculated by evaluation basis according to the score and weight of each element index. This could provide the policy-making basis for the reasonable and effective use of road transport system resources in Wuhan city.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-domain Policy-Based SLA Management Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: After analyzing the current IP QoS management models and the Policy-based management framework, this paper addresses the topic of constructing a SLA (Service Level Agreement) management model, including model construction, function modules description and related process explanation. On the basis of PBNM (Policy Based Network Management), a multi-domain policy-based SLA management model is presented, which includes three main SLA modules: automatic mapping, admission control and resource configuration. This model embeds SLA management into IP QoS management framework and induces multi-domain management architecture to extend PBNM centralized architecture. Finally, issues to be explored further in the future work are presented.

articleTitle: Finding Safe Shelters in Urban Areas for Earthquake Emergency Response through Web Processing Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Earthquake emergency response provides support for making judgments and decisions in order to reduce levels of casualties and economic losses during a state of emergency after the occurrence of an earthquake. In the relief activities, it is of vital importance to provide evacuees usually in panick with accurate safety information. Immediate assessments of victims, collapsed buildings, interruption of lifelines, halting transportation, fires and other collateral disasters are required for emergency response operations. This paper proposes a method of how to conduct immediate damage assessment to find the safe shelters in urban areas for earthquake emergency response through WPS. For representing the whole scenario, other OGC geospatial services, such as WFS, WMS and RS, are combined into a geospatial service chain in order to implement the application.

articleTitle: A Method to Estimate Watermark Invisibility before Embedding in DWT Domain
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: For invisible and robust watermarking schemes, estimation of watermark invisibility is necessary. Most of schemes estimate their watermark invisibility after watermark being embedded through experiments. In this paper, invisibility of watermark in DWT domain is analyzed. According to the properties of orthogonal DWT, we get the relation between variance of embedded watermark in DWT domain and the variance of noise it causes in spatial domain. Using this relation, we can estimate the PSNR of watermarked host image without experiments. This method is useful for watermarking scheme design. Experiments are done to testify the validity of this estimation method.

articleTitle: A Good Example for E-governance of Nature Reserve - Digital Jiuzhaigou Project
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Jiuzhai Valley or Jiuzhaigou National Park is located in Sichuan Province, South Western China, which was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1992. It has very good value of tourism development and scientific research. In order to enable a more effective protection, management and development, the Jiuzhaigou Administration Bureau has long started an integrated digital management project, Digital Jiuzhaigou. This project covers resources conservation, management & operation, tourism service & marketing, industry consolidation, etc. Great changes have taken place in the administration & management of the Jiuzhaigou since the initiation of this comprehensive e-government platform. This article is an individual case study of the management of Jiuzhaigou. It makes an analysis of the changes brought to the administration by the Digital Jiuzhaigou Project and draws a conclusion about management modes of info-tech-based environment and harmonization of natural resources protection & development.

articleTitle: Optimal Redundancy Calculation of Self-Cleansing Intrusion Tolerant System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Intrusion tolerance is the rising third generation technology of network security. The self-cleansing intrusion tolerant system (SCITS) is a typical application of this technology. Through quantifying the redundancy of SCITS, a conclusion that a specific SCITS has an optimal redundancy which can maximize its intrusion tolerant performance is obtained in this paper. The method of computing the optimal redundancy is given, and the effect of SCITS’s parameters on intrusion tolerant performance and optimal redundancy is analyzed through simulation. Lastly some notes about the design of SCITS are given based on the simulation.

articleTitle: A Business Process Management Infrastructure of Ertan Hydropower Company
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Technically, business process management (BPM) is a kind of new technology based on enterprise application integration and workflow. However, in business perspective, BPM is more than that. It can adapt the change outside and find out the solution through integrating legacy systems (including management systems) easily. BPM is based on an enterprise's strategy and has a set of operational theories and tools to transform an enterprise's strategy into operational processes. The same thing happens to Ertan Company. For developing the hydropower resources scientifically and efficiently on Yalong River, it is imperative for Ertan Company to treat the development of the river as a whole and to form an integrated management pattern including watershed management of the whole river, collectivization management and scientific management. The following crucial topics are waiting for answers: 1) the centralized control of the development and operation of the hydropower stations along the river, 2) the effective collaboration among multiple projects and multiple organizations, 3) the establishment of a new effective management system. This article begins with a literature review of BPM, and the necessity and feasibility of BPM to hydropower enterprise is discussed next. The core work of this article is to put forward an infrastructure named BPM-based river development and Operation Model. More details about the implementation of the model are discussed.

articleTitle: Optimal Combining Algorithm for Signal Arraying Using MMSE Weight Estimate
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: An optimal digital signal combining algorithm for arraying is proposed. Our approach is a blind combining technique, which doesn’t require any training sequence. In achieving coherence among various receivers, the combining algorithm attempts to maximize the combined output signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). It’s shown in numerical simulations that the combining loss of an 8-element array could limited to about 0.7dB at 2000 symbols /interval in low SNR ,which is about 2.5dB combining loss less than the traditional MMSE adaptive weight estimation using a single reference signal. This results suggests that the combining algorithm proposed here is capable of improving the combining SNR without complex computation.

articleTitle: Research on E-learning Based on Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: E-learning is different from traditional face-to-face education because it neither requires the teacher or the student to be in the same place, and often, not at the same time. This is accomplished is through digital technologies. This paper discusses e-learning with network technology as a teaching tool for college students. With the rapid development of Internet, network technology plays a more and more important role in education. E-learning is on easy and intuitive handling of the various network technology controls and can be widely used in different places. E-learning programs currently available come in a variety of formats and delivery methods. The e-learning environment and system is an ideal setting to promote greater involvement in mental capacities. Slightly more emphasis can be given to incorporating assignments that require synthesis of and making judgments on course-related materials. With the application of network technology, the e-learning will be more efficient for college students in higher education.

articleTitle: Cooperative Boundaries Tracking Model with a Mobile Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Inspired from social swarm intelligence, a cooperative boundaries tracking model with a mobile sensor network based on social foraging swarm behavior. In the model, the nodes of mobile sensor network are viewed as simple intelligent individuals of social swarm. The cooperative moving of the individuals is driven by sensed distribution environment. For boundaries tracking problems with mobile sensor network, the cooperative control strategy and algorithm is proposed, which supposed that global information of boundary curves is given and can be communicated between individuals. The stable analysis of the algorithm is provided. Finally, the experiment results with given boundary curve show the efficiently of the algorithm.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Bohai Cross Sea Channel Construction Investment to Economic Contribution
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The construction of Bohai cross sea channel is a comprehensive transport construction, mainly including railway, highway and waterway. Investments on the construction of transportation infrastructure have a great effect on the national economy of any country. Based on the input-output table in 2002, the paper applies the output multiplier, investment multiplier and employment multiplier and so on to predict quantitatively the contribution of the construction investment of Bohai cross sea channel to the national economy. This examination was done based on input-output method and industry correlation theory. The prediction result shows that the output multiplier is 2.5785, the investment multiplier is 1.2791, the employment multiplier is 750 and influence coefficient is 1.1468, which proves the influence of the construction of Bohai cross sea channel to other industries is higher than the average level and the construction provides its due contribution to the national economy.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Disaster Tolerant Architecture Based on Virtual Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: After 911 event happened in USA, there are increasingly companies beginning to take care of disaster tolerance. Great deals of companies pay huge money to construct disaster tolerant architecture. But this scheme is just suitable for big enterprise. Thatpsilas too expensive and inconvenient. In few years ago, there is a new way to store mass data called virtual storage. This could use the exited resource completely, and make it easy to construct the disaster tolerant architecture. According to the features of virtual storage technology and actual requirement of disaster tolerant system, and after analyzing the disadvantages of the traditional disaster tolerant architecture, this paper designed a hierarchical disaster tolerant architecture based on virtual storage technology. And then it made particular study on its working mechanism and realizable disaster tolerant function. This architecture used the transparence of virtual mapping and flexibility of virtual storage architecture. This makes a great improvement on the reliability of disaster tolerant system and enhances the flexibility of disaster tolerant strength adjustment.

articleTitle: The Influence of PROFIBUS Frame Transmission Time on Transmission Delay Property
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The transmission time delay property of fieldbus is an important factor that influences the real time property of industrial control networks. The frame transmission time of message is one important part of fieldbus transmission time delay, based on the fieldbus transmission time delay model. PROFIBUS frame transmission time mathematical model was proposed, for four data link layer severs of PROFIBUS. The correctness of frame transmission time mathematical model has been validated by the simulation.

articleTitle: DNS and LDAP's Integration and Design under Spring Frame Work
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: DNS is now a widespread network of Domain Name Service. The domain names and IP, which need to be resolved, are also stored in the correspondent database. However, with the increasing of the DNS function, some databases cannot be greatly expanded to store new data or cannot meet the requirements of high and efficient DNS service. This paper suggested ways to integrate the DNS and LDAP to achieve a more effective access and management.

articleTitle: Transition from IPv4 to IPv6 Based on Socket Applications
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, IPv4 will transform into Ipv6 step by step. Some network applications on the basis of IPv4 need to be transformed so that they can be executed under the IPv6 environment. To solve the problem of such transition, the socket interface and realization of IPv4 and Ipv6 are analyzed firstly in this paper. Based on the analysis, a feasible method is presented to realize such transition. This method has been applied into the experiment of protocol-independent Web server and reached satisfying results.

articleTitle: Tunnel Fire Staff Evacuation Channel Distance Design Based on EXODUS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Fire in the underground long and big tunnel is a serious accident. Itpsilas very essential to study the evacuation technology and rescue people in the fire situation. The authors do the theory research about the fire factors that affect the peoplepsilas lives in the tunnel, including high temperature, toxic gases, visibility and heat radiation and so on. Adopted the technical engineering risk theory, the fire evaluation is constructed as 5 levels. That is, 1 fire risk grade is Negligible, 2 is should be considered, 3 is serious, 4 is very serious and 5 is disastrous. Made level 2 as optimize criteria to design evacuation structure and use SMARTFIRE to emulate the fire scenario and import the results to BuildingEXODUS to simulate the evacuation. Contrast the several fire scales and distances between evacuation channels, when the distance between evacuation channels is 100 m, the staff can be evacuate successfully. And when the ventilation rate is 2.5 m/s can disturb smoke flow back effectively. The optimization result is below risk level 2. This risk can be accepted but need to be considered.

articleTitle: Constructing a Crisis Response System Using Artificial Intelligent Strategy
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the artificial intelligent system can help people solving some problems in some specific fields. In this paper, we describe the strategy of incorporating artificial intelligent into crisis response system. Finally, we illustrate the artificial intelligent crisis response system how to work when accident happened.

articleTitle: A Library's Environmental Monitoring System Based on Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to properly conserve the historical documents it is critical to continuously measure some parameters, such as temperature, relative humidity, light and, also, pollutants, either in repository or bookrack rooms. The deployment of a wireless sensor network in a library can help implementing these measurements in real-time, continuously, and in a much easier and cheap way. In this paper, we present a practical testbed deployed in the Hunan library, located in Changsha, China. This work is being developed in the context of an ongoing project on library environmental and structural monitoring using wireless sensor networks. The experimental testbed is described, as well as all the problems identified.

articleTitle: Research Standardization for Business Intelligence Systems Integration Based on SaaS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It is widely considered that standardization is an important means for information processing, exchanging, managing and clearing up technical bulwark more effectively. The paper studied the theoretics and methods about the SaaS platform. After analyzing the issues of standardization and existing standards for sustainable development information sharing (SDIS) such as XML, RosettaNet and so on. The paper provides researching results of standardization related to the business intelligence system and critical technology base on SaaS platform to implement the solution.

articleTitle: A New Rapid Algorithm for Detecting Human Head
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to the features of human head which is taken by camera shooting from the top down, this paper puts forward a new and rapid algorithm for detecting human head. First, the image is binarized by threshold, then searches diameter of circular-like head area in binary image. If the diameter is in conformity with the feature of human head, then identifies the possible head further in other directions. This algorithm avoids complex concepts and mathematical formulas. Its time-space complexity is much lower than other common methods used in detecting circular-like targets. This paper compares this algorithm with Hough Transform (HT) which is typical in detecting circular-like targets. It is several tens of times faster than HT, and the memory this algorithm needs is several tens of times less than HT. At the end of this paper, practice proves its good effect.

articleTitle: Rule Acquisition with an Entropy-Based Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper describes the implementation and the functioning of RAHGA (Rule Acquisition with an Entropy-based Genetic Algorithm), a genetic-algorithm-based data mining system suitable for both supervised and certain types of unsupervised knowledge extraction from large and possibly noisy databases. RAHGA differs from a standard Genetic Algorithm. We compared our approach with several other traditional data mining techniques. The results show that our approach outperformed others on both the prediction accuracy and the standard deviation.

articleTitle: Quantum Determined Key Distribution Scheme Using the Bell Measurement
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper we provide a quantum determined key distribution scheme. Unlike the previous schemes which produce a random string in the key distribution process as the key, in our scheme the two parties can share a predetermined binary string as the key with shared entangled states and performing CNOT operation and the Bell state measurement. The principles of quantum mechanics guarantees that no other people can get the key. So the scheme is unconditionally secure.

articleTitle: Construction of University Digital Library Resources under the Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This article discusses the concept of digital libraries and its main features. By introducing advanced digital library experience and technology of foreign colleges and universities, it presents that China should formulate an overall plan to specify the direction and objective of construction and set up clear constructive missions and functions based on its specific circumstances as well as learning from foreign universities. It also analyzes the existing problem in university digital library, and put forward the accordingly countermeasures and suggestions on the construction.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Public Need to the Government Community Medical Information: Taking Communities in Wuhan for Example
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: With the restructuring of unbans & rural areas and enterprise economic reform in China, large numbers of population come to be communities who have been the main clients of the government community medical information (GCMI). Taking the communities in Wuhan for samples, this paper investigates the main pubic who need GCMI, their main needs and the characters of their needs accoring to the demonstration ways. At last, In order to improve the management of the community medical organizations and to serve all the communities, it constructs the GCMI platform for the communities on the analysis of the survey above.

articleTitle: Constructing an Open-Sharing Chinese Scientific and Technical Vocabulary Service
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Chinese Scientific & Technical Vocabulary Service System is based on the traditional thesaurus resources by integrating some related tool suits and constructing more semantic relationship to provide S&T vocabulary knowledge service. In this project, a number of issues are being considered which include various methods to organize different vocabularies from dictionary, terminology and thesaurus, concepts, tools and policies to discover, manage and maintain the new concepts in a variety of domains, M2M interface to access the terminologies in the database, and mapping tools to improve the interoperability between different Chinese controlled vocabularies. This report is organized as follows: Section 1 introduces the background of this project. Section 2 describes the ways to organize different concepts in different disciplines. Section 3 presents the technical architecture of this terminology service. Section 4 describes the current situation of this project. Section 5 indicates the further development of this project.

articleTitle: The Construction of Sports Team Training Information Platform Based on Browser/Server and Client/Server
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
