abstract: Sports team training management information system basing on the B/S and C/S structure management was exploited by using the theory and methods of system engineering and the data-base technology. The development platform, requirement of the system function, the design of major function modules and the system safety of sports team management information system were discussed in order to make the training and management work scientific, standardization, automation, and intellectualization, and to enhance the management quality and achieves effective control over the process of the training.

articleTitle: Use and Gratification: A Pilot Research on Internet Writing Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the writing behaviors of Internet literature, hoping to understand the personal characters, writing motivations and behaviors of Internet writers, and to set up the preliminary image of Internet writings. Through in-depth interviews and questionnaire investigation, the study found a high consistency of personal traits within Internet writers. As for the writing motivations, the saying of “writing is just the purpose itself” is the most popular.  In addition, most of them like the interaction with other writers or readers.  With the interaction, they revise their own writing subjects and styles, showing the Internet writings are not one-way communications, but part of a social exchanging processes.

articleTitle: A New Proxy Multi-signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The proxy multi-signature is a very useful tool, which allows multiple signers to generate in a collaborative and simultaneous, and if a signer needs to delegate his signing capability to other signer, then the proxy signers can sign on behalf of an original signer. The paper proposed a new proxy multi-signature scheme, which the computation complicacy of the signature algorithm and the verification algorithm is independent of the number of signers. By verifying public-key, the new scheme can resist the forgery attack and the signing sequence of the proposed sequential scheme is fixed which unable to be changed freely by the signers. With the security analysis, it is a secure signature scheme.

articleTitle: Performance Monitoring Method for All-Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: All-Optical Networks provide ultra-fast data rates, but present a new set of challenges for network security. However optical performance monitoring (OPM) and optical network management (ONM) are essential in building a reliable, high-capacity, and service-differentiation enabled all-optical network. One of the serious problems with transparency is the fact that optical crosstalk is additive, and thus the aggregate effect of crosstalk over a whole AON may be more nefarious than a single point of crosstalk. Attacks can spread rapidly through the network, causing additional awkward failures and triggering multiple undesirable alarms, they must be detected and identified at any point in the network where they may occur. This results in the continuous monitoring and identification of the impairments becoming challenging in the event of transmission failures. However, a simple and reliable signal quality monitoring method does not exist at present. In this paper we present a novel method for attack identification and localization in networks with a minimum of complexity and cost. This method can participate in some tasks for fault management in optical network.

articleTitle: Researching of Real-Time Versions and Testing Its Performance of CNC System Based on RT-Linux
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Linux is a common time-sharing operating system. Due to its real-time task response time of great uncertainty and unpredictability, it has still many shortcomings while being applied to digital system. The paper discusses Linux-based real-time to improve on the basis of the use of software instrumentation technology for Linux and RT-Linux operating system for real-time targets evaluation form. The results showed that RT-Linux can well meet the numerical control system for real-time performance.

articleTitle: Application of PDE-Based Image Smoothing Method in Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Compared with traditional image smoothing method, partial differential equations -based image smoothing method is better in preserving image features while suppressing image noise. The PDE-based image denoising smoothing algorithm and an improved algorithm based on it are discussed in the paper. A good result is achieved in the experiment of identifying flaws on precise optical components’ surface with the application of the methods.

articleTitle: Insurance Information Management in China
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Information problems are particularly relevant and inherent for insurance market, thereby, it’s especially important to implement information management in insurance marketplace. Insurance information management involves not only the information management for insurance companies, but also for regulators and industry. And the main body to implement it does not only confine to information technical personnel, but all members of insurance organizations. In China, there’re many information problems in insurance market which would make undesirable outcomes, owing to the information asymmetries of policyholders, companies, agents, regulators and so on. We find some specific measures in the light of these problems to establish and improve information management system in Chinese insurance market based on its own market structure and conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Technology in Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In recent years, with the information increasing rapidly, WDM communication network traffic is paid more and more attentions. Traffic engineering (TE) is an interesting application in IP-based networks. TE main objective is to optimize the performance of a network through an efficient utilization of network resources. This paper discusses traffic technology and load balancing in optical networks. Traffic engineering involves adapting the routing of traffic to the network conditions, with the joint goals of good user performance and efficient use of network resources. In the network planning and in the evaluation of the effects of the changes in routing parameters, a network-wide view of traffic is crucial. The local traffic conditions, such as link loads, are just the result of the routing decisions already made in the network.

articleTitle: The Multi-channel Dispersion and Dispersion Slope Compensation by the SNLCFBG
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the paper, we investigate the reflect spectrum and time delay of SNLCFBG by means of the numerical simulation which be used to compensated dispersion and dispersion slope. The counting method of multi-channel numbers about SNLCFBG is proposed using the sampled rate of the NLCFBG. Then, the versatile formula of counting multi-channel number is pre-calculated to out-of-band multi-channel number on the main petal and the first side petal. The value region of chirped parameter and of the SNLCFBG are analyzed. The peaks of reflect spectrum of the SNLCFBG have a relation with modulation degree. Also, we investigate the relation between the sampled rate and multi-channel equilibrium.

articleTitle: PDM-Based Product Design Knowledge Integration
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To manage the knowledge of product development period efficiently, a PDM-based product design knowledge management model was proposed. According to the different characters of tacit knowledge and explicit knowledge, a design knowledge classification and related-representation method were introduced. The integration model between PDM and product design knowledge flow which is the key part of the design knowledge management was constructed. Some key technologies such as PDM-based knowledge navigation, and knowledge retrieval were discussed in detail.

articleTitle: An Improved Optimal Algorithm for a Location Choice Problem
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper presents an improved optimal location choice in a network. The location choice model considers not only the maximum distances between the vertices but also the sum of the whole cost, which is a common problem in our society.

articleTitle: The QoS Routing Protocol in the Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper has introduced several QoS routing protocols in the ad hoc networks. And it elaborates the development tendency in the future through comparing several important QoS routing protocols in the ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: Design of Data Management Framework Based on Ontology in Distributed Cooperative Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In Distributed Virtual Environment, the number of data is very large. How to effectively manage and share these data was very important. Ontology is a philosophical concept originally. It can realize knowledge sharing and reusing. According to the character of ontology, a new data management framework ODMF was put forwarded in this paper. This framework was based on ontology and all data information was standardized. In this framework, ontology was used to realize data sharing. Because data model has different type, this new framework architecture has three different types. And a disease data ontology was built in experiment. Experimental results show that using this framework can solve the problem of data sharing. Otherwise, data using efficiency was improved.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Boolean Functions for Pair Sharing Analysis

articleTitle: Design Principles and Methods of Activities for Teachers' Online Training
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The traditional teachers’ training model hardly offers high order skills for teachers, so it must be broken. In online training for teachers, teacher’s professional abilities can be improved effectively by taking activity-based training. Combineing own training experiences and actual conditions of teachers, we explore training process based on activity, and have achieved more ideal results through practice. This paper introduces design principles and methods of activities for teachers’ online training.

articleTitle: A Shortest Coding Schemata (SCS) for Level Classify
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: It is necessary for many different information processing systems to make coding to the information entities with sorts or levels in a system. The design and structure of coding have a high effect on the data access and operating in a system. This paper mainly studies the effectiveness of coding depended on good memory and operations, and proposes a shortest coding schemata (SCS) demonstrating much superiority in computer information processing based on above. It has a feather of unfixed length, and its mean characters of input code are constant O(1) in the retrieving and editing, which is superior to general field sequence code (FSC) that is O(n) in code characters inputted and utility.

articleTitle: Design of Resources in E-learning: Ecology Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: From ecology perspectives, resource is a kind of living entity. We present the design lifecycle of resources in e-learning by the Deming spiral, as an organizational tool. The four steps in approaching to a sustainable development are being proposed: analysis, design, evaluation and optimization. And it is discussed that ecological factors of resources are role, property and architecture in e-learning. The three-dimensional model about ecological factors of resources is constructed. Learners are more, and some less, influenced by the context when performing a skill or learning. One of the most differences between individuals is the distinction between ‘field dependence’ and ‘field independence’. Evaluation system of two-dimensional quality is applied into design. It is necessary for decrease entropy to reduce cognitive load.

articleTitle: Study of WF-C-Means Algorithm for CBR Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: A successful Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) system lightly depends on how to design an accurate and efficient case retrieval mechanism. Brand extension is widely applied as a corporate strategy in the economic life. Some companies succeed in brand extension, some fail. So it is very important to study the case and theory of brand extension. Brand extension has its own background and reasons. Brand extension is not only the way to use the brand equity but also the way to increase the brand equity. Brand extension has different types including line extension, associated brand, etc. Different type of brand has different brand extension capacity. The brand that belongs to nonobjective type has best extension capacity. The extension capacity of brand that belongs to functional or technical type cannot compare with nonobjective type. In this research we propose a Weighted Feature C-means clustering algorithm (WF-C-means) to group all prior cases in the case base into several clusters. In the last few years the catena supermarket had the quick development in the our country , but produce the power not clear in meaning , conduct not norm ,the merchandise man agent level fall behind , the marketing management level is low , conducting the cost to reside further develop met that the high not inferior problem obstructed the catena supermarket . For this, the catena supermarket busyness enterprise should ask for help the policy to stupor, managing as soon as possible to produce the power relation fluently, make use of the information technique exaltation cost control ability, and build up the new relation with supplier. Through our experiments, the efforts of this research are useful for real world CBR systems.

articleTitle: Auto-Adapted Long-Distance Education System Model Based on Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In the past, the design and development of distance learning systems commonly use the programming methods of process-oriented and object-oriented. Then, in this article Agent technology is used for distance learning environment to create and organize and manage. In the distance learning system of Agent, first of all, establishing a model which is composed by single Agent of the internal structure; then start to design, develop Agent for the distance learning system from the perspective of Multi-Agent; use the Multi-Agent technology, to design the Multi-Agent system which is based on the objectives and explore the system's implementation.

articleTitle: Design of Fuzzy Controller with Self-Regulation Factor and Integral Aspect of Self-Adjusting Link
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper presents a fuzzy control method with self-regulation factors and integral parameter self-tuning link for the problem of poor dynamic accuracy existed in traditional fuzzy control. This method adds optimization of adjustment factors and a self-adaptive coefficient integrator based on the conventional fuzzy control. Theoretical analysis and MATLAB simulation results show the effectiveness of the application of fuzzy controller with self-regulation factor and self-adaptive integrator studied by this article to the control system. In comparison with ordinary fuzzy control and PID control, the system achieved good, satisfactory results in dynamic response, anti-interference ability, enhancing robustness and so on.

articleTitle: Study on Fairness Property and Liveness Property of Temporal Logic of Action
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper introduces about temporal logic of action, it discuss the relation among closure, security, fairness property and liveness property in TLA, action and point out and weak fairness and strong fairness as prerequisites, base on this, it discrible in detail how to establish system model with machine-closed through cases, in the end we gain correct conclusion.

articleTitle: An Active Index Caching Search Algorithm for Unstructured P2P Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Unstructured P2P networks usually adopt flooding algorithms for searching and locating resources in the network. However, flooding algorithms turn to produce a large number of query messages, thus, restrict the P2P networks' expansibility. By studying existing improvements on searching strategies, this paper proposes a new one based on the idea of Active Index Caching. The new algorithm actively publishes indices of new resources to other nodes in P2P networks. Experimental results show that the new algorithm outperforms the existing ones.

articleTitle: Techniques Analysis for Implementing Shared Relocatable Buffers Using the TMS320 DSP Algorithm Standard
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents several techniques supported by the TMS320 DSP algorithm standard (referred to as XDAIS) which can be employed by algorithm writers to assist application developers in optimizing their systempsilas performance and sharing of memory resources. The first technique is based on using statically allocated global data structures. The second technique is built on the concepts of scratch memory and memory overlaying techniques based on algorithm activation and deactivation. The last technique is referred to as the write-once buffers technique and support sharing of re-locatable read-only data across instances of a common algorithm.

articleTitle: SIRS Epidemic Model with Immunization on Sparsely Distributed Regular Lattice
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, a SIRS epidemic model with immunization on sparsely distributed regular lattice is proposed. Based on the model, we research the effects of immunized rate, crowd-density, spread efficiency and moving activity of agents on disease spread. The theoretical analysis and analog simulation indicate that immunization can increase the spreading threshold. Besides, there is a critical threshold which is related to spread efficiency and crowd-density in this model. Only the product of spread efficiency and crowd density is beyond the threshold, can the disease spread in crowd continuously and steadily. Our research also shows that moving activity of agents can promote the disease spread.

articleTitle: An Energy-Related Routing Algorithm of Interlaced Cobweb Model in Multi-sink Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), energy of the sensor nodes applied by battery is the important resource. Though multi-sink wireless sensor networks can reduce the length of path to sink nodes, an economical and efficient routing algorithm is still indispensable for improving the utilization of energy. This paper proposes an interlaced cobweb model (ICobM) and an energy-related routing algorithm in ICobM (IC_ER) based on the speciality of multi-sink WSNs. In ICobM, the nodes only maintain the simple information of neighbors and the minimum hops to all sink nodes. In IC_ER, data packets are forwarded among the neighbor nodes with maximum residual energy and reach the nearest sink node finally. The results of analysis and experiments show ICobM model and IC_ER routing algorithm have outstanding performance in packets delay, dissipated energy and lifetime of network.

articleTitle: A Web Prediction Pattern Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Recommender system can predict and recommend end users their probably most interesting commodities after abstracting their interest and preference through their browsing information. In this paper, we accordingly abstract user preference to predict the users’ coming access webpage to prefetch them. Through an optimized clustering and sequence mining algorithm, a recommender system is realized to predict user preference webpage. Experiments prove the precision and applicability of system

articleTitle: ERP System Selection Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper looks at the selection process of ERP systems based on SVM methodology, basing its findings in an extensive study of 40 questionnaires that have gone through the planning process. 9 second indices and 25 third grade indices are identified and examine. Evaluation model is established by case analysis. By planning the selection systematically and thoroughly, buyers can identify ERP software and vendors that genuinely meet their needs.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Rural Infrastructure and Economic Growth Based on Partial Least-Squares Regression
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The rural infrastructure plays an increasingly important role in economic growth. This paper extends the partial least-square (PLS) method into rural infrastructure analysis. Because the economic factors which influent rural infrastructure usually are multicollinearity, PLS can avoids this problem. PLS extracts variables one by one from few sample data. Under the control of modeling, it makes fully use of the useful information contained in the raw data. The experiments show that this method is feasible in analysis of the relationship between infrastructure and rural economic than OLS or ANN.

articleTitle: Research on VRML Modeling for Web-Based Virtual Product Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper, we present the methods to develop the Web-based virtual product that is capable to dynamically simulate machine processes in solid graphics form through the Internet. The methods include the function-based virtual reality modeling language (VRML)shape modeling, which allows the content creators to describe any complex models with the mapping-based Route and Events description; the interaction of the virtual product realizing with drag sensors (DSs) of VRML, which allows users to be capable of handling virtual product with any desired precision. We illustrate the implementation of the proposed methods on the example of the interactive function-based shape modeling and DSs.

articleTitle: The Research of the Most Short-Path's Chinese Words Segmentation Words Model Based on N1
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This article introduced in the natural language understanding's Chinese segmentation words technology, elaborated emphatically segmentation wordspsila method and implement principle based on the statistical, proposed by based on statistical segmentation words technology primarily ldquocompound prescriptionrdquo segmentation method, in the analysis words segmentation process a N- most short-path's statistical model, has caused Chinese segmentation words technology had the certain extent enhancement in the efficiency and the rate of accuracy.

articleTitle: Innovation of Excel Integrated Server in Enterprise Information Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Information technology has brought profound changes to global market competition and enterprise management mode. Essence of enterprise management informationization is development and application of information resources in their depth and scope. In recent years, Beijing CESoft Co., Ltd. had promoted designing tools and operating platform for Excel server information system, and have integrated electronic table Excel with the database SQL Server into a working environment of network data business coordination, so that users can set up such management information system as OA, ERP, CRM, and SCM etc, that apply to market changes in a free, relaxed and fast way.

articleTitle: A Low Cost Real-Time Communication System of Locomotive Based on GPS
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this paper we propose a mobile communication solution of real-time operating data for moving locomotive without the railway GSM (GSM-R).The method exploits a low cost communication system based on GPS. Through the existed train dispatching radio communication system (TDRCS) and the railway packet switched network (RPSN), the real-time operating data which transacted by data-voice synchronous wireless dispatching communication subsystem can transmit to the ground data processing subsystem,and then the real-time data can be shared by other local railroadpsilas dispatching centers,stations along the railroad, railway branch locomotive depots and other railway units.The system have the advantage of low cost and easy to achieve.

articleTitle: Virtual Community in Service for Real Estate Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper proposes a project called “Choose your neighbor online” which has constructed an virtual community in order to strengthen the social networking relationship between people, especially between neighbors, and resist indifference in modern society. The digital community simulates the real states of online purchasing process and living of householders which are constructed by 3D network game engine. Customers who have registered in the community can play their roles and choose any entertainment or any interesting person they like to talk with. Meanwhile, advanced online house purchasing substitutes for the present tedious purchasing process which costs lots of human and material resources and then brings the real estate developer huge benefit. This is a totally innovative and meaningful mode of house selling. Following the user experience design method and user-centered interaction principle, this paper explains the whole process of system development and the application prospect of this interactive community.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Model of Virtual Human-Shoes System Based on Fuzzy Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To improve the quality of shoes, extensive testing was applied to obtain a high comfort shoe model based on human biomechanics and the interaction system of human-shoes. By studying the mechanical properties of the human body on two aspects: joints and muscles, the mechanical conduction model of the lower limbs was established through the foot testing, and found that Pedar foot measuring points was simplified from 99 to 25 through the association rules reduction algorithm which does not change peoplepsilas comfort degree. The experiments showed that this method is feasible, and the simulation results and actual test results have a high degree of anastomosis. Hence, virtue human-shoes system makes the enterprises to avoid the unsuitable shoes products entering the market in the digital design stage of shoes whereas it can make enterprises to save the cost of the product development.

articleTitle: An Approach for Discovering Rare High-Density Outlier Cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Outlier detection is one of the common tasks in engineering applications. Its aim is to identify uncommon records from large amounts of data. Many efforts have been done to reach this goal. But different approach should be introduced according to different application area. In some engineering cases, much frequency uncommon records may appear in a short time. In this paper, a new method is put forward to identify these uncommon records. This method is constructed based on density-based outlier discovering method. In this method, a ratio factor is used to illustrate the high-density percentage of all records. If the ratio is under a threshold the high-density records would be considered as outlier, otherwise these records would be considered as normal. Experiments show this method could effectively discovery these rare high-density data.

articleTitle: Web Gambling with the 4Cs Marketing Framework: Macau's Perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Internet changed the concept and the way of marketing in recent years. Gaming industry pays much more attention on its marketing strategy with Internet concerns. Web gambling is a good example to show how Internet makes traditional gaming industry and operators more influential and profitable. The paper discusses the extension of the traditional marketing 4Ps to innovative 4Cs in web gambling (or online gambling). Lots of practical examples of how Macau conducts its web gambling in the new marketing framework were provided.

articleTitle: A Combination Multi-signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The concept of the multi-signature was first proposed by Itakura and Nakamura, in which multiple signers can cooperate to sign the same message and any verifier can verify the validity of the multi-signature. After that, a lot of multi-signature schemes were proposed, but almost all of the multi-signature schemes are either sequence multi-signature or broadcasting multi-signature, but a lot of examples need the two schemes combine each other. This paper proposed a new combination multi-signature based on the difficulty of the discrete logarithm problem. The public key and length of the signature in the new scheme have independent of the number of signature members. With checking of pubic key, it can resist the forgery attack, so it is a secure and effective signature scheme.

articleTitle: Study on Parallel Clustering Based on Asynchronous Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In order to improve the speed of clustering data mining, aiming at the characteristics of BIRCH algorithm, this paper has done research and analysis on rapid clustering data mining in the cluster system, and presented several improvement suggestions such as using data parallel thinking, uniform data distribution strategy , clustering communication mode and the optimization of clustering results. Experiment results show that the paralleling algorithm using asynchronous communication can achieve better performance and speedup than that synchronous one.

articleTitle: Vocabulary Knowledge Stored in Connectionist Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to connectionism theory, words do not exist in isolation; but always form structural sets of elements together with other conceptually related words that have a reciprocal influence on each other, and word meanings are defined through the sense relations. By constructing sense relations of words, semantic sets are established which give great precision in guiding students towards meaning and help them to reinforce the learning of another word.

articleTitle: NAGUAL: A Novel Automated Trust Negotiation Model Based on Attribute Constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Automated trust negotiation (ATN) is a promising approach which establishes mutual trust between strangers through the iterative disclosure of digital credentials and access control policies of the two negotiation parties. Although many ATN systems are proposed, some issues still remain to be addressed: (1) their policy languages are coarse-grained; (2) they cannot generate all trust sequences and are short of the mechanism for evaluating trust sequences and selecting an optimal one. Therefore, we present a novel ATN, called NAGUAL. First, attribute constraint is introduced into NAGUAL in order to refine its policy language, which cannot only protect sensitive services and certificates effectively, but also enhance the flexibility of NAGUAL. Second, global access control policy is used to terminate impossible negotiation in advance, which can improve the negotiation efficiency of NAGUAL. Third, we describe the process of generating trust sequence using trust sequence search tree. Based on that tree, breadth-first can generate a trust sequence or all ones. Last, we evaluate trust sequences through disclosure cost and communication overhead for attribute certificates, which facilitates selecting an optimal one. This paper illuminates the usage of NAGUAL by using a typical example.

articleTitle: Research of Wireless Data Transmission Based on Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper reports on an approach to data transmission in wireless mobile networks, based on embedded system. A methodology and a design flow for wireless data transmission is presented. ADC has been used for hardware design for sometime, but is now being extended to software design application by adding the MCU as one of ADC controller.The approach relies on the exploitation of the features of the applications of wireless mobile communication technology and short messages data transmission technology. Also a further optimization is given to the data packet and sending technology; the author made a test based on these technologies, and achieved the desired results.

articleTitle: Study of RSVP Routing Protocol in Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the relations of the QoS parameters in wireless Ad hoc networks, we proposed a new route found mechanism. The new mechanism calculate the length of the routing, the throughput require of the data transmit as bandwidth, and by the most of the bandwidth require to Resource Reservation to meet the QoS. Simulation result shows that it can meet the QoS require if the network allow.

articleTitle: Dynamic Diffusion of Innovations: A Leader-Imitator Combined Structure Pattern
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: In this research, a model of diffusion of innovations was built in markets where the set of ultimate adopters consists of two segments: leaders, who are more in touch with new developments and who also affect the other segment, pure imitators, whose own adoptions do not affect leaders. The main results are: (1) the speed of innovations diffusion is not a monotonic process but a process of ascending in the beginning and descending after; (2) diffusion in a mixture of leaders and imitators can exhibit a ldquogaprdquo between the early and later stages of the diffusion curve; (3) leaders play a critical role in the whole process of innovations diffusion.

articleTitle: Assessment of Network Teaching Resources Based on Fuzzy Synthesize Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Fuzzy synthesize evaluation is an effective multifactor decision-making method on making a comprehensive assessment of things influenced by many factors. In this paper we use a fuzzy synthesize evaluation method to assess the network teaching resources, and give an example to show its application.

articleTitle: A Multi-level Tree Overlay Network for Application Service Provider Platforms Based on Manufacturing Grid
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Resource sharing on manufacturing grid (MG) consists of two parts: resource provision and resource application, which are connected by resource discovery. With focus on resource application, this paper studies the problem of resource discovery in broad area. In order to solve problems with centralism and distributional structure for ASP deployment, we propose a multilevel-tree overlay network structure for ASP deployment. Its nodes are highly autonomous and mutually supportive, thus they form tight and flexible information route topology. Among its many enterprise-oriented and application-oriented features, this structure allows for retrieval and multi-spot discovery of resource in broad area. We describe the process of resource discovery based on the structure in detail. Finally, its validity was illustrated with quantified examples and a demo prototype.

articleTitle: Study on the Improvement of Encryption Algorithm of Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Bluetooth is a low-cost short-range wireless communications technology standard, widely used in business. But now people may pay a heavy price for the incompatible, security and other problems of the Bluetooth. In this paper, on the basis of technical defects of the Bluetooth encryption, DES algorithm is used to improve the practical measures to enable Bluetooth technology to play an important role for military purposes.

articleTitle: Ellipsoidal Method for Shadow Detection Based on Normalized RGB Values
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper presents a new approach of foreground and shadow segmentation in visual surveillance environment. Coordinate systems are firstly defined based on normalized RGB values, and then an ellipsoid is constructed according to scattering feature of shadow pixels. Consequently, moving shadow detection is treated as a clustering problem in above coordinate systems, and all the pixels inside the ellipsoid are extracted as potential shadow pixels. Finally, post-processing is further performed by using the geometrical properties of shadow to verify and confirm pixels classified as shadows in previous step. Experimental results validate the algorithm on a suite of indoor and outdoor video sequences. The performance of the method is markedly higher than that of the two well-known moving shadow detection methods, especially under changing illumination conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Active Push Model for Product Development
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: To meet the needs of knowledge management for product development, a knowledge active push model was proposed. The knowledge flow of the active push mechanism was analyzed as well as design knowledge organization and knowledge match of the system. A multi-table-based knowledge discovery method was introduced. To push the right knowledge to the right person, a knowledge-weight-based active push algorithm was put forward. Finally the effects of the active push model were concluded, and the future work that needs to be done is also discussed.

articleTitle: On the Construction of Digital Community Colleges with Chinese Characteristics Based on the Distance Education System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Community colleges and distance education play a decisive role not only in the national education but also in the long life educational system. To realize the lifelong learning and construct the learning society, we must step on the only way of making full use of the current distance education system. This paper illustrates the experience of several successful community colleges and distance education in some countries, analyzes the current development of community colleges and distance education in China, and brings forward an effective mode to construct digital community colleges with Chinese characteristics by utilizing the distance education system.

articleTitle: Image Compression Based on Fast Lifting Waveletransform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Image matching is an effective auxiliary location method for the precise guide weapon system. The image sensor of image matching system is used to real-time gather the object image around target or that throughout the flight way, which will be compared with the reference data of the upper computer in the missile, to process and locate the correct position of the target relative to the missile. The performance of the image matching system is vitally interrelated to the geographic and conditions (Ground image characteristics) of the operation region. So the basic operation condition of the image matching system and matching region selection in the special geographic conditions is regarded as the main contents to study. Taken the developing demands of an important national defense weapon system as the background, we carry out a series of theory analysis and simulation study base on the actual data, in order to improve the matching accuracy of the down-look image matching system and determine the main factors influencing the operation performance of the image matching system in further. And we build a set of functional relationship relative to the performance and specifications of the image matching system, image statistic parameters and operation conditions. By analyzing and verifying these functions relationship, finally we point out the parameters influencing the image matching system under different environmental conditions, and point out principle thought and method of selecting image matching area according to these parameters. These study results have been used and proved in the product development. And it provides the basis for us to determine the selection regulations of matching area of down-look system, laying a foundation for improving the operation performance of the image matching system in different environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Wireless Network Security Policy Based on Integrated Vulnerability Management
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Most security issues of wireless network are focused on preventing attacks from the outsiders or wireless users. However, these authorized wireless users have no right to take part in the drawing up security policy of an organization. Besides, the larger network scales the more difficulty to be maintained. Patching and managing the mass of computer vulnerabilities are a timely but critical issue. A system, the integrated vulnerabilities management system, is proposed to help users efficiently accessing information, easily getting solutions and conveniently communicating others. Not only the security administrators can get aid but also the other managers and employees could be supported with this system.

articleTitle: The P2P Network Resources Localization Algorithm Research and Improvement Based on JXTA Platform
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This article has analyzed the principle of JXTA network resources localization mechanism thoroughly. In view of the existing problem of JXTA network resource localization mechanism, proposes a new algorithm thinking which combines small world and the interest weaken mechanism of rumors spread, and replaced the inherent strategy by using the dynamic long chain replacement to improve the problem of binding choose the rendezvous peer in the JXTA network.

articleTitle: Detection and Performance of Coded FSK Wireless Telemeter Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The noncoherent symbol-by-symbol maximum a posteriori (MAP) detection and the soft-decision Viterbi decoding in a convolutionally coded frequency shift-keying (FSK) telemeter system are studied and the performance of coded FSK telemeter system in flat Rayleigh-fading channel is also analyzed. The coded bit metrics of FSK signal are calculated by MAP detector, and the bit metrics are applied in realization of soft-decision Viterbi decoding. The results show that the reliability of FSK telemeter system can be improved by MAP detection and soft-decision Viterbi decoding. Compared with the envelop detection and hard-decoding of coded FSK signal over flat Rayleigh-fading channel, the potential gain of 6-8 dB can be obtained by using MAP detection and soft-decision Viterbi detection.

articleTitle: The Research of Three-Dimensional Coverage Question in Random Deployment Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Through researching coverage controlling algorithm which is randomly deployed at three-dimensional space sensor network;a random covering model of the three-dimensional node triangle cone-shape space overlap territory is established. In allusion of the model, a kind of three dimensional covering algorithm is proposed, which both take the node position into consideration and considering the sensation time of neighbor node and the excess energy. The simulation experiment prove that the textual algorithm can solve the three dimensional covering problem of sensor network effectively, reduce the network load and node load and extend the lifetime of sensor network ,adopt the real situation of network deployment much more.

articleTitle: Link Connectivity Analysis Models of Satellite Communications Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Space-based information transmission is the tie between the acquisition and the application of space-based information, and satellite communications network is one of the development tendencies of satellite communication. Some conditions must be satisfied to establish timely communication links between two satellites to provide robust operation and connectivity. This paper addresses the issue of link connectivity analysis of satellite communications network, and discusses the main models for visibility and signal propagation to analyze link connectivity characteristics. The results can be used in satellite network communication system effectiveness evaluation and satellite communication system simulation.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation of Anycast Service in Mobile IPv6 Network
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This paper has proposed a new kind of anycast communication model in mobile IPv6 network which is built on mobile node tree technology. Mobile node tree technology combines unicast technology and multicast technology, namely, it adopts the Unicast routing technology to forward anycast packets and utilizes the multicast tree technology to manage and maintain anycast members. In this model, each mobile node has only one permanent address - home address by which it can communicate with clients, and when a mobile node moves from the home area to the foreign area it does not need to register itself with its home agent and not to build a tunnel to transfer data packet, or in route optimization it does not need to send an address-binding message to clients. In addition, this model can perform IPSec which is difficult to be implemented in the existing mobile IP communication model. The experimental data in IPv6 simulation indicate that the performance of Anycast service(for example, file downloading service) acquired in this model is better than the one in tunnel model of mobile IP communication.

articleTitle: On the Construction of Resource-Library-Based Network Teaching Platform of English Extensive Reading
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The construction of resource library-based network teaching platform of English Extensive reading course is the actual manifestation of the rapid development of network communication technology and multimedia technology. Pre-build the network resource library is a prerequisite of the construction of network teaching platform of English Extensive reading course. The network teaching platform mainly is composed by curriculum teaching platform, the management system and auxiliary teaching resource library. Generally speaking, there are three education models in applying the resource library-based network teaching platform to the teaching practice of English extensive reading course: mass instruction model, group collaborative model, and autonomous learning model.

articleTitle: P2P-Based Live Media Streaming System
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: According to the problems of existing live media streaming system, a P2P-based live media streaming system is brought forward, each peer in the system is not only consumer of live streaming service, but also provider of live streaming service. It overcomes the server bottleneck of current existing systems when the user scale is large, and has the characteristic of low requirement of network bandwidth and server processing ability, easy deployment and high scalability.

articleTitle: The Digital Television Multimedia Message Service Flows
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: This dissertation studies the Multimedia Message Service flows that based on the digital television system. In this paper, the Digital television is called TVMMS for short. TVMMS uplink service flow and downlink service flow will be discussed. The author also discussed the TVMMS address encoding and addressing scheme. We can perform the uplink service and downlink service and point to point service through the TVMMS system. TVMMS will greatly enrich the application of digital television.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Management Experiment of Securities Regulation
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: Based on the theory of behavioral finance, this paper studies the securities regulation by using the research method of management experiment. The paper designs and analyzes a management experiment of securities regulation by combining some experimental results of the bubble problem of security market with the DHS model of behavioral finance. In the management experiment, securities regulation factors and management psychology factors are introduced. The management experiment provides a method of valifying the effectiveness of securities regulation measures and is useful for studying the investment behavior of decision-making of investors.

articleTitle: A Typed Process Calculus for Dynamic Web Data
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: We present a typed process calculus for dynamic web data. It features web data in networks, hyperlinks, service calls, scripts, dynamically accessing data and typing. In this paper, a typing system disciplines data handing at the level of channels and processes. We proved subject reduction theorem which says that well-type will be preserved by reduction in the typing system.

articleTitle: Research Automated Negotiation Framework for Business Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The paper analyzes the current situation of business environment and business intelligence systems framework at first, and studies the theoretics and methods about the business intelligence system. Analyzes the necessity of an automated negotiation method in the manufacturing resource management system (MRMS) based on the manufacture requirement and latency manufacturing resource state, order enterprise can find forwardly or passively some manufacturers satisfying it’s manufacturing tasks requirement Taking into account justice, multi-topics influence genes, and negotiation both sides preference, etc. It can help confirm the keystone of the construction of business intelligence systems and the negotiation business model of MRMS.

articleTitle: 3G Mobile Phone Usage in China: Viewpoint from Innovation Diffusion Theory and Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2009 International Conference on Networking and Digital Society
abstract: The rapid development of wireless communication technology along with the increasing usage of the Internet has promoted mobile business as well as significant increase in consumers. Third generation (3G) mobile phone becomes more and more popular in many countries. However, the development and popularity of 3G in China was hampered. To answer it, this paper analyzed the reasons behind through Innovation Diffusion Theory (IDT) and Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) perspectives. Some suggestions are also given to 3G business operators and researchers.
